If you could do many more, use a slightly harder setup; if six clean reps are not possible, lower the feet or use ordinary floor pushups. Record elevation or tempo.
push.progress: After two comparable top-range sessions with at least two clean reps left, lower the incline, add a slow lowering phase, or raise the feet a small amount. Change one variable and rebuild from six reps.
